explanation: The first preorder value is the root. Find it in inorder, slice the left and right traversal sequences, and recursively construct those subtrees. Distinct values make the split unique.
timeComplexity: O(n²) worst-case time for n nodes, including repeated searches and traversal-slice copies in a skew tree.
spaceComplexity: O(n²) worst-case auxiliary slice storage retained across recursion, plus O(n) output nodes.
attribution: Original repository-authored Blind75 C++ algorithm, promoted from the validated correct fixtures. Collection membership follows Crackr; no external solution service is used.
